summary: Iteration 15 near_sort=price feature fully verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (price ascending with SOLD last, distance default, radius_km combination, pagination, regression total=45, nearest-without-coords fallback). Frontend (mobile 390): Pilih Titik apply shows 'Urutkan:' row (nearsort-row/nearsort-distance/nearsort-price); Harga Termurah re-orders list exactly matching API price order with first card = lowest price (Rp 16.5 Jt); Terdekat restores distance order; clearing origin (X pill) hides both Radius and Urutkan rows; re-enabling nearest defaults to Terdekat; radius 25km + price sort works (10 cards). No credentials needed (public catalog).

minor.issue: near_sort accepts any arbitrary string and silently falls back to distance ordering instead of validating (e.g. 400 for invalid value). Low risk since only the frontend sends it.

issues: radiusRow style (shared by Radius and new Urutkan rows) has no paddingHorizontal, so 'Radius:'/'Urutkan:' labels start flush at the screen's left edge (visible slight clipping at 390px). All other header rows use spacing.lg horizontal padding. Minor cosmetic inconsistency.

action_items: Optional: add paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg to radiusRow style in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx so Radius/Urutkan labels align with the rest of the header.
Optional: validate near_sort query param (distance|price) in public_catalog and return 400 on invalid values.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend nearest branch loads all matching assets into memory for haversine sorting before paginating (pre-existing pattern); fine at current 45-asset scale but will not scale to thousands of assets.
Frontend correctly resets nearSort to 'distance' on all three origin-clear paths (chip-terdekat toggle, clear-origin-filter pill, reset-filter-empty).
No deprecated Expo packages, no _id leakage, no hardcoded URLs found in reviewed code.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 45 published demo assets (includes SOLD items and assets across Indonesia for distance/price variation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: near_sort=price verified end-to-end. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration15.py (9 tests, all green). Frontend flow: chip-pilih-titik -> apply-map-pick -> nearsort-row; default modal point is lat=-6.2,lng=106.8166. Catalog total without origin is 45. Public URL via EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Feature works as specified.
